newsitem.title: POLAND: WBK buys 87 pct of ailing GBH bank.
newsitem.headline: WBK buys 87 pct of ailing GBH bank.

text.p: Polish bank Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy SA (WBK)has paid 25 million zlotys for an 86.9-percent stake in small ailing Gliwicki Bank Handlowy SA (GBH), WBK said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said the stake gave it 85.4 percent of GBH shareholder votes.
In July WBK pledged to buy at least 75 percent of GBH, which is based in the southern Silesia region where it has nine branches and 21 retail outlets.
WBK has said GBH will maintain a separate identity and receive help in overcoming financial problems.
GBH, burdened with an estimated 24 million zlotys in losses, had own funds of 20 million zlotys and a balance sheet total of 212.7 million at the end of April.
